decisions.reason: Turnaround management is central to the firm's data-driven airport operations strategy and has a dedicated page, so continued investment is likely.
Apron connectivity enables the integrated platform, though it may eventually be folded into a broader suite rather than withdrawn outright.
Billing software sits further from the operational core but provides recurring software revenue and ties into airport resource data.
Equipment monitoring builds on the installed apron hardware base and supports the expanding maintenance and service business.
Apron resource management complements turnaround and planning software within the integrated suite.
Controller safety alerts match the firm's tower expertise, and safety products in aviation have long lifecycles.
